subject: Really happy with the office chair I bought
body:
Hi there,

I just wanted to write in about the office chair I picked up from your Pudong store a couple of weeks ago. I'd been putting off replacing my old one for ages, and honestly I wasn't sure what to expect, but the staff there were patient with all my questions and didn't rush me at all.

Now that I've been using it every day, I have to say it's made a real difference — my back isn't complaining the way it used to after a long day at the desk. It feels solid and well made, and the adjustments were easy to figure out.

I don't usually bother writing these things, but I thought someone should know. Please pass on my thanks to the team there.

Best regards,
A happy customer
